tasks.subject: Task 1: OffPeakAvailabilityMonitor service
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A polled, thread-safe availability-status service exposing a UI display string and a cached `isWindowOpen` for the forwarder.

**Files:**
- Create: `ModelProxy/Services/OffPeakAvailabilityMonitor.swift`
- Test: `ModelProxyTests/OffPeakAvailabilityMonitorTests.swift`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `@Observable final class … @unchecked Sendable` with NSLock-guarded status; enum idle/open/closedUntil(Date)/unavailable(String).
- `start()` idempotent; probes immediately then every 300 s (`pollIntervalSeconds`).
- Probe success canTakeNumber true → .open; false → .closedUntil(Date(timeIntervalSince1970: nextTakeAtSeconds)).
- Probe throw → .unavailable(String(describing:)) and polling CONTINUES (fail-open status).
- `stop()` cancels and resets to .idle; no status writes after stop.
- `isWindowOpen` true only for .open; lock-guarded, any thread.
- `displayString`: "Off" / "Window open" / "Closed until HH:mm" (`date.formatted(date: .omitted, time: .shortened)`) / "Unavailable (…)".

**Verify:** `xcodebuild test -project ZGate.xcodeproj -scheme ZGate -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:ModelProxyTests/OffPeakAvailabilityMonitorTests` → all pass.


tasks.subject: Task 4: Forwarder off-peak dispatch with gated fallback
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Route requests whose matched target is the off-peak vendor: all gates pass → OffPeakTarget.serve; any gate fails → the rule's backup target; no backup → clear 503. Non-streaming requests NEVER queue (compaction lockout class).

**Files:**
- Modify: `ModelProxy/Proxy/ProxyForwarder.swift:433-470` (new branch before relay branch), `ModelProxy/Proxy/ProxyChannelHandler.swift:125-143` (thread offPeak + monitor into forward), `ModelProxy/Services/OffPeakAvailabilityMonitor.swift` (OffPeakAvailabilityMonitoring protocol)
- Test: `ModelProxyTests/ProxyForwarderTests.swift` (append)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- forward gains offPeakContext + offPeakMonitor params; protocol `OffPeakAvailabilityMonitoring { var isWindowOpen: Bool { get } }` for test stubs.
- Gates: context.configuration().enabled && (monitor?.isWindowOpen ?? false) && Self.requestIsStream(forwardBodyData). NO request-time availability call on the hot path.
- Gates pass → OffPeakTarget.serve(targetModel: target.targetModel, vendorID: target.vendorID) then return (LocalTarget channel-writing contract; body reconstituted via ByteBuffer(data:)).
- Gate fails → backup via router.targets(for:) re-dispatched on the normal path; AppLog.info names gate + fallback target (model only, no bodies).
- No backup → sendAnthropicError 503 type "off_peak_unavailable" message "The off-peak window is closed and this rule has no backup target."
- requestIsStream helper with unit coverage.
- Five tests: nonStream→backup, windowClosed→backup, disabled→backup, noBackup→503, gatesOpen→ticket plane serves + stats row under off-peak vendor ID.

**Verify:** `xcodebuild test … -only-testing:ModelProxyTests/ProxyForwarderTests` → all pass; ProxySessionIntegrationTests green.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["ModelProxy/Proxy/ProxyForwarder.swift", "ModelProxy/Proxy/ProxyChannelHandler.swift", "ModelProxy/Services/OffPeakAvailabilityMonitor.swift", "ModelProxyTests/ProxyForwarderTests.swift"], "verifyCommand": "xcodebuild test -project ZGate.xcodeproj -scheme ZGate -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:ModelProxyTests/ProxyForwarderTests", "acceptanceCriteria": ["gates = enabled ∧ windowOpen ∧ stream; no hot-path availability call", "any gate failure serves the rule backup; no backup answers 503 off_peak_unavailable", "non-streaming requests never reach the ticket plane nor async_stream_required through a rule", "gates-open path serves via ticket plane with token stats under the off-peak vendor ID"], "modelTier": "capable"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: ProxyServer monitor wiring + no-restart toggle
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Build/start/stop the availability monitor with the live toggle — Settings flips apply without restart; mint-on-enable falls out of the first poll (RelayHealth.fallbackKey chain — verify by reading, no new mint code).

**Files:**
- Modify: `ModelProxy/Proxy/ProxyServer.swift:303-326` (build beside context in start), `:541-571` (updateRouting start/stop), expose `private(set) var offPeakMonitor: OffPeakAvailabilityMonitor?`
- Test: `ModelProxyTests/OffPeakMonitorWiringTests.swift` (new)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- start(): after the offPeakContext build block, if config.offPeak.enabled build monitor (probe = makeTicketClient().availability()) and start().
- updateRouting(): after updateConfiguration — enabled ∧ monitor exists → start(); enabled ∧ monitor nil ∧ context exists → build+start; disabled → stop(). Idempotent.
- Test seam `offPeakProbeOverride` (mirrors quotaProvider injection at :350-358): start disabled → updateRouting(enabled) → probe called ≥1; updateRouting(disabled) → status .idle and probe call count freezes.
- stop() nils offPeakMonitor; restart rebuilds it.

**Verify:** `xcodebuild test … -only-testing:ModelProxyTests/OffPeakMonitorWiringTests` → pass; ProxySessionIntegrationTests green.


tasks.subject: Task 8: Docs, README matrix, CHANGELOG draft
tasks.description:

- CHANGELOG Unreleased: toggle (no-restart), availability status + popover row, rule-target routing with fallback, colored toggles, token stats on /async.
